name: GSI Proposal Architecture, SOW Margin & Bench Factory
description: Models consulting delivery staffing pyramids and onshore/offshore margin leverage, audits SOW drafts for scope creep phrasing and margin breaches, and matches open project roles to bench consultants.

skills.summary: Calculates multi-phase effort hours, onshore/offshore leverage ratio, blended bill rate, and gross margin vs SOW floor.
Lints SOW drafts for unbounded 'all work required' obligations, missing acceptance criteria, >10d deemed acceptance, and margin floors.
Matches open project seats against bench skills, roll-off dates, location overlap, and target role margin.

byo_mcp: Workday HRIS & PSA Staffing MCP server
connectors.connector_fetch_guidance: Pull rate cards, SOW milestone drafts, and RFP requirements from Google Drive/SharePoint plus consultant skill inventories and clearance eligibility from Workday/PSA MCP servers via remote_cli mcp before Python staffing and margin checks.

gateway_approval_actions: Submitting below-margin or high-risk SOW bids for Practice VP / Finance sign-off in PSA MCP
Assigning bench consultants or initiating subcontractor requisitions in Workday/PSA MCP
Sending client proposal decks or redlined SOWs externally via Gmail or Outlook
python_code_guardrails: Onshore/offshore leverage ratio, blended cost/bill rate, and hard minimum gross-margin floor guard
Mandatory security-clearance and availability window matching before bench allocation
Unlimited-revisions and deemed-acceptance SOW legal/margin risk clause flagging

scheduled_routine.name: weekly-bench-utilization-digest
scheduled_routine.title: Weekly Bench Utilization Digest
scheduled_routine.instruction: Run the weekly bench-to-demand skill matching check via scripts/talent_bench_matcher.py and surface unfilled roles needing subcontractor sourcing.
